feeds.title: Sum on Sleeve Blog
feeds.description: My BLOG is to reminisce about moments in my childhood and reflect on them as they come up for my daughter. I am Katharine Chan. I have over a decade of experience working in healthcare. I've worked in emergency health services, mental health, women's health, facilitating, coaching, and promoting honest conversations among healthcare leaders to enable organizational change.

feeds.title: Pretty Petunias
feeds.description: Pretty Petunias is where I share my love of baked goods and family recipes! It's a platform for style, family adventures and hilarious life moments. A place to find the design and craft projects or trips to Paris we take. Hi, I'm Laura. The voice behind Pretty Petunias. I love photography, baking and funny life moments!

feeds.title: Powered By Mom Blog
feeds.description: On Powered by Mom you can discover easy and delicious recipes from appetizers, main dishes to desserts, helpful pet & travel articles, tips & everyday adventures in life. It is a family-friendly site and we have a team of writers, all moms with children of different ages.

feeds.title: Nikki Blogs
feeds.description: My blog shares tips for new moms and teaches how to earn money by starting a mom blog and how to get paid on Instagram. I'm Nikki! I'm a mom to two amazing little girls, a wife, and business owner.

feeds.title: Kali Desautels Speaks
feeds.description: Originally intended to simply focus on book reviews, over time, KaliDesautelsReads has morphed into its own entity. I write about issues that are near to my heart, be they political, feminist, motherhood, mental health, or, as the title holds, books.

feeds.title: This Vancouver Mom
feeds.description: Explore tips and advice on motherhood, know about challenges to face and overcome, and much more on This Vancouver Mom! Hi, my name is Maria. This blog is my account of the challenges faced as a new mother.

feeds.title: A Life Well Consumed
feeds.description: A Vancouver-based lifestyle blog created by Leslie Rossi. A Life Well Consumed is filled with informative and fun content covering a variety of topics such as travel, beauty, motherhood, food, and lifestyle. Leslie Rossi is a Vancouver-based blogger and YouTuber who specializes in everything beauty, travel and cocktails.

feeds.title: Hello Creative Family
feeds.description: Hello Creative Family believes that Creative parents raise creative kids therefore they help parents ignite their creative spark so they can raise their kids in a homemade, handmade, heart-made home. It is the go-to resource for parents looking to ignite their creative passion with simple, everyday and back-to-basics projects.

feeds.title: Vancouver Mom
feeds.description: With 1000s of family friendly Vancouver ideas to keep kids busy, VancouverMom.ca is a guide for moms on how to do Vancouver with kids. Published since 2009, VancouverMom.ca gives today's urbanite parents the best places to eat, shop, play and live with their kids. From epic playgrounds with a view to rainy day drop-ins to the most unique summer camps, VancouverMom.ca will keep local families off their screens and loving where they live.

feeds.title: Discovering Parenthood
feeds.description: Discovering Parenthood is about what life has been like since we became parents, and all the adventures that have followed. We started this blog after our oldest daughter was born. It was suggested to us as something to do as an outlet for the emotions that come with being a new parent.

feeds.title: Pint Size Pilot Blog
feeds.description: The family travel blog offers wary parents tips and advice, destination and hotel suggestions, and useful product information - to take the fear out of traveling with little ones. Get survival tips and advice for travel with babies, toddlers and kids.

feeds.title: The Agency Blog
feeds.description: The Agency Blog is for a community of everyday women: those who love knowing about the latest in fashion, trending beauty products and tips, must-haves for the little ones and how to still be you amongst all that life has in store. Today, readers can expect to see topics ranging from style, beauty, home, baby, motherhood, and much more.

feeds.title: She Wears Love
feeds.description: Welcome to She Wears Love where you can find my picks of the latest trends in fashion, beauty, lifestyle and more! My name is Amrit Heer. I'm from beautiful Vancouver, British Columbia. I'm a Wife, a Mom to three beautiful babies and a Model.

feeds.title: Nourish Through Movement
feeds.description: I document my adventures as a kinesiologist, rekindle my old love for DIY and style and continue to find nourishment through movement, while integrating it all with motherhood, family and all the other curveballs that life decides to throw over. I'm just a kinesiologist who's balancing parenthood, friends and fitness.

feeds.title: The Urban Mom
feeds.description: A fun and adventurous Mom of 2 littles and a dog. I passionately blog about creating fun memories and helping new Moms make connections so the journey is less lonely.

feeds.title: The Loquacious Lemonade Life
feeds.description: This a blog about a family where everyone is loquacious, and life is all about making lemonade and turning sour things into sweet treats.

feeds.title: Parenting From The Heart Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Alana. Having studied development psychology during my undergrad, my parenting can best be defined as influenced by a little bit of research, a bit of family tradition, a bit of instinct, and a whole lot of love. Being at home with my two very young toddlers has yielded so many life lessons, as well as a perpetual need for coffee. I wanted to share some of what we do and some of the things we learned along the way.

feeds.title: Athenas Angulo
feeds.description: Here I'll be sharing tips about marketing, blogging, health and wellness and raw motherhood. My name is Athenas Angulo, I'm a mother of 2, Marketing Strategist, Content Creator, Instagram Influencer, Webinar Host and Blogger.

feeds.title: Ava To Zoe
feeds.description: Ava to Zoe is a Vancouver Based Lifestyle Blog that is play on Janette's two young daughters' names. Ava To Zoe is a safe place to fall & know you're not alone! You can expect fun recipes, honest & real reviews, travel and everything in between!

feeds.title: Heydy Lopez
feeds.description: Hi! I'm HeydyLopez and this is my life & style blog, documenting and showcasing my life as a young mother to my three sweet boys, Jayden, Abel, and Isaiah. My blog provides a brief, but very real, insight into my personal experience through teen pregnancy without the cameras.
